# 01-04. Run model and prediction scripts 
Description: Runs random forest classification model (stage 1) and regression model (stage 2) based on observed densification 2013-2023. Predicts densification based on parcel data 2023.

## Function for running script 1-4
The function runs the modelling/prediction steps for all four parcel types and knits the respective html documents. 

```{r}
run_model_pipeline <- function(models,
                               base_path = paste0(my_wd, "/code/models_and_predictions")) {
  
  rmd_files <- c(
    "01_rf_classification_model.Rmd",
    "02_rf_regression_model.Rmd",
    "03_rf_classification_prediction.Rmd",
    "04_rf_regression_prediction.Rmd"
  )
  
  for (selected_model in models) {
    
    message("==== Running pipeline for: ", selected_model, " ====")
    
    for (rmd in rmd_files) {
      
      input_file <- file.path(base_path, rmd)
      
      output_file <- paste0(
        tools::file_path_sans_ext(rmd),
        "_", selected_model,
        ".html"
      )
      
      message("Rendering: ", rmd)
      
      render(
        input = input_file,
        params = list(run_id = selected_model),
        output_file = output_file,
        envir = new.env() 
      )
    }
    
    message("==== Finished: ", selected_model, " ====\n")
  }
}
```

## Run function for all parceltypes

```{r}
# all parcel types
models <- c(
  "bu_nonres",
  "bu_res_sfh",
  "bu_res_mfh",
  "nbu"
)

run_model_pipeline(models)
```
